QM Homework

Gold M5

I read several times the Marketpedia but still the QM dynamic is not very clear to me. While a QM is forming, the engulf of previous demand for us is a strong signal that price wants to go lower, so we wait the FTR to sell at Supply of Higher High (Head) or previous High (left Shoulder). My question is: why the big market players let engulfing previous demand, wich tells us that price wants to reverse? If they need to fill their sell order, isn't enough waiting for people buyng at a pullback of the trend (higher low in an uptrend) and suddenly push the price lower without any warning? What kind of benefit do they have from engulfing previous demand and not simply consume it to prepare the sell off? Probably I don't understand the market dynamic behind the QM and why it occours the way it does, but I can't figure out why. What do you think?
